title: Rahmanullah Gurbaz withdraws from LPL 2026
summary:
Rahmanullah Gurbaz has announced that he will not join the Kandy Royals for the 2026 Lanka Premier League despite being selected by the franchise.



The Afghanistan wicketkeeper-batter noted that he will be unavailable due to commitments in the Shpageeza Cricket League.
